hero_headline: From Raw Content to Published Video
hero_sub: AuraFlux is a six-stage automated production pipeline. You submit a job. The pipeline handles clip selection, scripting, editing, QA, brand application, and direct publish — without a single manual step.

portals.name: Content Intelligence
portals.description: Source video analysis, segment detection, and clip scoring. The system identifies which moments are worth producing before any editing begins.

portals.name: Script & Voice
portals.description: AI-generated script tailored to your content type and platform format. ElevenLabs TTS voiceover produced at broadcast quality.

portals.name: Edit & Assembly
portals.description: Automated cutting, reframing, captions, and timeline assembly. Every clip assembled to spec without manual intervention.

portals.name: Quality Assurance
portals.description: Automated QA gates check for brand compliance, audio quality, caption accuracy, and platform spec conformance before publish.

portals.name: Brand & Effects
portals.description: Lower thirds, watermarks, background music, and colour grading applied from your brand preset. Consistent across every output.

portals.name: Publish
portals.description: Direct publish to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch, or Kick via secure OAuth. Metadata, captions, and scheduling handled automatically.

content_types.name: Highlight Clips
content_types.description: Best moments from streams and VODs — auto-cut, captioned, and formatted for short-form.

content_types.name: Gameplay Commentary
content_types.description: AI-generated narration over gameplay clips — personalised to your style and audience.

content_types.name: Show & Film Analysis
content_types.description: Narrated breakdowns from TV and movie clips — fair-use formatted and ready to publish.

content_types.name: Live Event Recap
content_types.description: Sports, news, and live events turned into structured recap videos within minutes of the event.

pipeline_sub: Six portals. Each one checks the work before the next begins.
content_types_sub: Four content formats, each with its own production logic.
features_sub: Every capability available inside the AuraFlux platform.
credits_body: One credit = one complete production job. Credits are consumed when a job starts and refund automatically if the job fails.
publish_sub: Connect your accounts once. AuraFlux handles the rest via OAuth.
